# Dokploy Community Edition

> Dokploy Community Edition is a self-hosted community fork of Dokploy, the platform for deploying applications, databases and Docker Compose stacks. It is upstream Dokploy v0.30.8 plus 100+ community features and fixes ported 1:1 with credit to their authors, native integrations (Uptimely, Snapvisor, DoDomain, Sendly, Notifly), a remote MCP server and fork-only security hardening. It is not affiliated with the Dokploy project. Switching from official Dokploy keeps all data, and switching back is supported.

## Install and upgrade

- [README: install, switch from Dokploy, features](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community#readme): Fresh install with `curl -sSL https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/install.sh | sh`, one-command switch from official Dokploy with `docker service update --image ghcr.io/devinosolutions/dokploy-community:v0.30.8-community.10 --with-registry-auth dokploy`, and the full feature list.
- [Site home](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/): The same README as a web page, including the list of what is different from upstream Dokploy.
- [Docker image tags](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community#docker-image): ghcr.io/devinosolutions/dokploy-community with versioned tags (for example v0.30.8-community.10), `latest` for the latest release and `canary` for the latest build. Recent release images are multi-arch (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64).
- [Versioning](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community#versioning): Tags follow the scheme v<upstream-version>-community.<release>.

## Features

- [Integrations](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/integrations/): Settings → Integrations setup for Uptimely uptime monitors, Snapvisor visual testing on preview deployments, DoDomain custom-domain DNS verification, and the Sendly and Notifly notification providers.
- [Uptimely monitoring](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/integrations/#uptimely-uptime-ssl-and-domain-monitoring): One Website monitor per HTTPS domain from a service's Monitoring tab, checked every 5 minutes, with a 30-day timeline.
- [Snapvisor visual testing](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/integrations/#snapvisor-visual-testing-on-preview-deployments): Visual-diff review status on preview deployments, looked up by commit SHA.
- [DoDomain domain connect](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/integrations/#dodomain-custom-domain-connect-and-dns-verification): Domain owners connect DNS through a hosted flow and Dokploy shows the verification state.
- [Built-in MCP server](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community#remote-mcp-server-with-oauth-fork-original): Dokploy serves its own remote MCP server at `https://<your-dokploy>/api/mcp` with OAuth sign-in, so Claude Code and other MCP clients need no local process and no API key: `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user dokploy https://<host>/api/mcp`, then authenticate in the browser. An API key in the `x-api-key` header also works.

## FAQ

- [Frequently asked questions](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/faq/): What the fork is, affiliation with Dokploy, install and migration, going back to official Dokploy, multi-arch images, connecting Claude Code over MCP, large GitHub push webhooks (413, payloads up to 25 MB), service status after saving provider settings, connecting DoDomain, uptime monitoring, moving a service to another server, the container log viewer, upstream sync and telemetry.

## Source and support

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community): Source code, README and contribution guide.
- [Releases](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community/releases): Release notes and credited change lists for every version.
- [Issues](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/dokploy-community/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.

- [Upstream Dokploy](https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy): The original project this fork is based on.
- [Install script](https://dokploy-community.devino.ca/install.sh): The script behind the fresh-install command.
